messages:
elaine_cs: Quick HarborHealth VPC onboarding check-in. TL;DR: transit peering done, security team still needs to approve KMS policy, audit logs not yet forwarded. Customer has a compliance milestone on 2026-05-30; missing audit logs would be a renewal risk. Can we triage now?

sam_eng: @elaine_cs got it. I can pick up firewall rules + IAM role mapping. Do we have the customer CIDR and expected public egress IPs?

dinesh_sre: I pulled their topology file earlier today (shared in the onboarding doc). I'll import BGP/export routes into staging and validate no overlapping prefixes. If egress IPs are missing I'll ask them for NAT ranges.

maria_sec: On KMS: they created the key but the key policy only allows the account root. Need to add our `redwood-private-deploy` service principal and their cross-account role. Posting suggestion snippet to the doc. Also want to confirm they want KMS multi-region replication later — flagging for Q3 enablement.

elaine_cs: Adding two notes: 1) Audit logs must be forwarded to the customer's S3 bucket with ACLs we can read for retention verification. 2) Customer asked for an enablement session for their SecOps team next week.

sam_eng: I'll aim to have firewall + IAM mapping by EOD and will attach the terraform snippet to the ticket. Example rule I'm starting from: `aws_security_group_rule` allow on ports 443/10250 from their CIDR.

dinesh_sre: I'll validate the S3 sink permissions and retention. If we can't confirm AWS CloudTrail -> S3 -> Athena path today, that's the main blocker for the compliance milestone.

maria_sec: I've opened internal review with security-approvals and put the KMS policy in draft. Quick capture: customer wants HSM-backed key but not EKM yet — capture that as a future ask.

deploybot: Ticket created: CS-4123 HarborHealth private onboarding - tracks firewall, KMS policy, audit logs, enablement.

elaine_cs: Ok next steps and owners: Sam -> firewall + IAM mapping (CS-4123), Dinesh -> audit sink validation (CS-4123), Maria -> KMS policy + approval (CS-4123), Elaine -> schedule SecOps enablement + renewal readout. 2pm sync confirmed — please drop blockers before then. :thumbsup:
